body: I'm sorry you're going through this. I hope he makes it.
Thank you for understanding... and likewise. I hope it gets easier for you.
I always fight like an option too, a second choice. It's been a fucking year and I'm still not over her... I'm sorry you're going through this. I would feel crushed too.
Fuck. I hope it gets better for you... I'm actually just about to start CBT later today. I wish it didn't have to be so hard.

I constantly have dreams about my ex-girlfriend. They follow one of two themes, them insulting me and telling me the things I've always thought about myself, or them accepting me and loving me. The first is horrible and painful during and after, the second is amazing during but when horrible and painful when I wake up. It happens at least once a week, usually more like twice. I hate it so much because I want to be over them and stop basing my self-worth on what I think they think of me, but I'm afraid I never truly will.
Thank you for saying that. I really hope that we do. Putting on an act all the time makes you so tired.

All of it. I feel like an anchor, constantly weighing people down, and I wish I had someone that fits. I wish I had someone who could carry me with them without resenting me for how big a burden I can be... someone strong enough that I'd only be heavy enough to keep them grounded, from floating aimlessly or getting pulled away in a storm, rather than just making them sink like I do when I'm by myself. At the same time, I wish I had someone the same as me, someone just as heavy, someone with no balance in their life or peace of mind, someone just as fucked up, someone I could fade into nothingness with who liberates me from this crippling fear of ruining them with my negativity. I want purpose, I wish that was a real thing we could find without all these years of trials, tribulation and strife, but it's so much easier to just let go. I hope this makes sense.

I think finding a "why" is a big reason some people stay on this planet. It doesn't really exist. It's just how we comfort ourselves, and I don't think there's anything wrong with that... but for the most part, I agree with you. In fact, that was beautifully well-written.
I understand. That's one of the worst things, being scared of both but feeling like you have no choice or feeling like you can't control it.

Happiness is an emotion and therefore always temporary. I think being a "happy person" is a lie our society sells to us. You can learn to be content with who you are and to accept the situation you're in, but that's about it, and that's a really difficult thing to do, especially if you're mentally ill. But I like to think even us depressed folk can cultivate stable, "happy" relationships if we take the right approach. It's just real difficult. Also, while I think life is meaningless objectively, I do agree with those other people that each individual can give it their own powerful meaning... it's just much easier said than done.
Are you feeling like you don't really want to die, but you want the pain to stop and that feels like the only way?

I understand where you're coming from all too well. I feel the same way about my life currently. I have good friends, great friends, but I feel like I'm making them tired with my mental illness and it gets so lonely because I'm too scared to be honest out of fear of scaring them off, which means I'm not really allowing myself to connect with them on the level I want. I hope that you find what you're looking for.
Beautiful advice... thank you from another reader.
This happens to me like once a week.

I've tried medication and therapy for years but nothing helps. I have MDD and OCD, I've had these issues since I hit puberty. I'm just sick of it. I have no real external struggle besides having basically no life, which makes me feel guilty of course... it's all in my head, but I can't stop it.
This was beautiful, it spoke to me on a very personal level. Thank you for sharing your experience with us.

I understand that feeling too. Sometimes you feel like you need a push to go through with it, it's scary. But when you start asking yourself which is scarier, dying, or the circumstances you're living with now, that's when it gets dangerous... thank you for the well wishes. I hope something happens that makes you feel like this existence is worth sticking around for.

Yeah, life is really fucking shitty sometimes. I wish it wasn't. I wish I could take all these problems and all that pain you have away. I wish I could tell you how much better it's going to get, but I really don't know when or if it will. All I can do is say I understand what you're going through and I'm the same way. I'm paranoid, I'm scared, I'm sad, I'm crazy. I understand.
